scope_note: C043 is a proof-carrying algorithmic specialization for globally bounded maximum live signed support of affine-subspace arrangements. It inherits the C042 basis contract and does not solve unrestricted subspace avoidance, arbitrary CNF, or P versus NP.

sources.title: CNF Satisfiability in a Subspace and Related Problems
sources.role: Primary unrestricted SUB-SAT / Union-of-Subspace Avoidance hardness boundary. C043 accepts only when its deterministically built live signed support remains within a fixed polynomial capability.

sources.title: Characteristic Polynomials of Subspace Arrangements and Finite Fields
sources.role: Primary finite-field method relating complement counts to arrangement characteristic polynomials.

sources.title: Subspace Arrangements over Finite Fields: Cohomological and Enumerative Aspects
sources.role: Primary context for counting points on and off unions of finite-field linear or affine subspaces from arrangement data.

sources.title: On Valuations, the Characteristic Polynomial, and Complex Subspace Arrangements
sources.role: Primary valuation and characteristic-polynomial context for subspace arrangements.
Supplies the charged affine parameterization, RREF provenance, coordinate forms, SAT witness lifting and verifier primitives inherited by C043.
Shows that coordinate substitution alone reproduces arbitrary source 3-CNF; C043 therefore requires bounded live signed support and returns OPEN on registered hard-image pressure.
Reserved future specification for localizing superpolynomial global support. It is not part of the C043 theorem or implementation candidate.
